question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- The question asks for top-level packaging containers where any item has total quantity > 500,
-- and we need the names of both the containers and the corresponding items.
-- 
-- Let me get the final answer: top-level packaging containers and their items where total_qty > 500

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id as top_id,
        p.name as top_name,
        p.id as current_id,
        p.name as current_name,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) as accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.top_id,
        pt.top_name,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        p2.name as current_name,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
    JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
)
SELECT 
    pt.top_name,
    pt.current_name as item_name,
    SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) as total_qty
FROM packaging_tree pt
WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
GROUP BY pt.top_name, pt.current_name, pt.current_id
HAVING SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) > 500
ORDER BY pt.top_name, pt.current_name

-- that are contained within each top-level packaging, with total quantity accumulated 
-- across all nested levels.
-- 
-- The hierarchy is:
-- Pallet of L (531) -> Box Large (521) -> Bottle 500cl (502)  [qty: 12 * 72]
-- Pallet of M (532) -> Box Medium (522) -> Bottle 330cl (501)  [qty: 20 * 36]
-- Pallet Mix MS (533) -> Box Medium (522) -> Bottle 330cl (501)  [qty: 10 * 36]
-- Pallet Mix MS (533) -> Box Small (523) -> Bottle 500cl (502)  [qty: 20 * 30]
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Box Small (523) -> Bottle 500cl (502)  [qty: 20 * 20]
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Gift Box (524) -> Gift Carton (511) -> Bottle 330cl (501) [16 * 8 * 3]
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Gift Box (524) -> Gift Carton (511) -> Bottle 500cl (502) [16 * 8 * 2]
--
-- We need to recursively traverse the hierarchy to compute total quantities for each leaf item

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Now I need to recursively trace from each top-level packaging down to all leaf items,
-- multiplying quantities at each level.
-- 
-- I'll use a recursive CTE to traverse the hierarchy.
-- Start from top-level packaging (not contained in any other), and recursively follow
-- the packaging_relations to find all contained items, accumulating quantities.

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Base case: start from top-level packaging containers
    SELECT 
        p.id as top_id,
        p.name as top_name,
        p.id as current_id,
        p.name as current_name,
        1 as level,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) as accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow children
    SELECT 
        pt.top_id,
        pt.top_name,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        p2.name as current_name,
        pt.level + 1,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
    JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
)
SELECT * FROM packaging_tree ORDER BY top_id, current_id, level"}
